stem: What happens next in this passage after “Not everything can be saved.”?
options: A boy once asked him, "Why repair old clocks Phones can tell time."
A repair café received an old sewing machine.
It was hard to believe that something so old had once been important.
Some parts are too old, and some machines are too dangerous to repair.

本文沒有陳述「A repair café received an old sewing machine.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「It was hard to believe that something so old had once been important.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
